posts.name: Cuts
posts.tagline: Turn photos and clips into polished video stories
posts.description: Cuts is a template-based video editor for iPhone and iPad. Pick a vertical template, add photos and clips, customize animated text, and export in 1080p. Built-in layouts, transitions, filters, and film grain help you create travel stories, product promos, and everyday edits. Save projects and return to them later. Free to download, with optional Plus and Pro subscriptions.

posts.name: REsimpli
posts.tagline: AI-Powered All-in-One CRM for Real Estate Investors
posts.description: REsimpli is an AI-powered, all-in-one real estate CRM and investment management software designed for real estate investors, wholesalers, and house flippers. The cloud-based platform offers lead management, skip tracing, list stacking, Driving for Dollars, marketing automation, AI-powered follow-ups, sales pipeline management, and accounting tools to streamline business operations and manage real estate deals.

posts.name: LearnXops Build Your Own Lab
posts.tagline: Turn any tech topic into a tested hands-on lab with AI
posts.description: Name any tech topic and pick a regular lab, a Kubernetes lab or an AI agent lab. Your own AI agent writes a scenario with 3 to 6 tasks, each with a hint, a solution and a check. The LearnXops desktop app then tests every task on your computer: each check must fail before its solution and pass after it. Failing steps get fixed and tested again, and only a lab where every task passes is saved to My Labs, ready with a terminal, hints and an AI coach. Beta, for Pro members.

posts.name: LBC Nobody suspects the SUBS
posts.tagline: How to spy on your crush secretly.
posts.description: How to spy on your crush secretly Nobody suspects the submarine. Your Mac's little secret agent. Looks suspicious. Records everything. Your secret screen recording weapon. Stalk your screen. Not your crush. A little spying never hurt anyone. The most suspicious screen recorder. Your Mac has a secret. Record everything.

posts.name: LINARY
posts.tagline: See what your LINE chats reveal about your relationship
posts.description: LINARY analyzes the LINE chat history you export (.txt) and turns it into insight: message counts and balance, reply speed, most-used phrases and emojis, and active hours. It estimates compatibility, interest and communication tendencies in the style of MBTI / Big Five, and works with group chats too. Your guide is Olo, a fortune-teller character who transforms into a crystal ball. Available on iOS and Android. Note: the app is in Japanese.

posts.name: Sepiasend
posts.tagline: Resend's API on Cloudflare: same code, lower bill
posts.description: Keep Resend's SDK and send through your own Cloudflare account. Change two environment variables; Cloudflare delivers at its own price, domains are unlimited and free. Includes an MCP server so Claude and coding agents can set it all up. By Squidcode.

posts.name: HireMe.so
posts.tagline: Tailor your resume to each job with AI
posts.description: Paste a job link or description to tailor your resume to the role using your real experience. Review and edit the draft before exporting. Create a matching cover letter, prep for interviews, and track your applications in one place.

Free to download, with optional Plus and Pro subscriptions.

posts.name: Sarthisetu
posts.tagline: Turn ideas into live websites, apps and automated workflows.
posts.description: Simply describe your idea, and Sarthisetu handles the rest by building and deploying live websites and applications. It seamlessly connects your favorite tools to streamline your entire development workflow into one workspace. If you are visionary and want to build something there is no other alternative than Sarthisetu.

posts.name: GetLeads
posts.tagline: Unlimited B2B Lead Database
posts.description: Connect your AI agent to 542M+ B2B contacts, local businesses, and job posts via MCP. Search, enrich, and filter leads in plain language. No exports, no dashboards - just ask your AI.

posts.name: PayAgent
posts.tagline: One payment rail for humans and AI agents
posts.description: PayAgent gives people and AI agents the same way to pay and get paid in USDC and USDT. Send a payment link, an invoice or your pay page, and anyone can pay it from their wallet. Agents use the API with spend policies you set: caps, allowlists, and your approval above any amount. No active policy? The API refuses to approve or record it. Non-custodial, verified on-chain, and no cut of the amount. The sender pays the network gas. Live on Ethereum, Base and Solana.

posts.name: YuanYu Church
posts.tagline: A peaceful virtual church you can visit anytime, anywhere.
posts.description: Discover a peaceful virtual church where you can take a moment to pray, reflect, and reconnect with your faith. Explore a beautiful 3D church, light a candle, say a prayer, and enjoy a quiet moment of reflection — all from your browser, without downloading an app or creating an account. Whether you're busy with everyday life, far from a physical church, or simply looking for a quiet place to pray, YuanYu Virtual Church is always open to welcome you.

posts.name: Sticker World
posts.tagline: Design 3D stickers, wax seals, badges & pop-up cards online
posts.description: Sticker World is an interactive browser 3D studio for decorating 3D objects with holographic stickers, stamping 3D wax seals, designing 58mm pin badges, and building 3D pop-up greeting cards. Turn photos into die-cut PNG stickers, generate designs with AI, or browse original sticker packs. Try the 3D studio free as a guest—no signup required—and export PNG, GIF, MP4, or printable A4 sheets.

posts.name: BOL AI
posts.tagline: BOL AI is a voice-first AI assistant from Pakistan
posts.description: Bol AI makes artificial intelligence simple and accessible. Talk, ask questions, share images and get AI assistance without complicated prompts. Features include Voice AI, Camera AI, Text Chat, Text-to-Voice, Voice Notes, QR & Barcode Tools, and Fingerprint Lock. Supporting 12 languages, Bol AI brings multiple AI capabilities together in one Android app. Talk. Ask. Show. Understand. Explore: https://bolai.pk

posts.name: Redis TUI
posts.tagline: Find big Redis keys from Bash or PowerShell
posts.description: Sample memory-heavy keys by node and prefix, page through large collections, and preview JSON. Redis TUI supports standalone Redis and clusters, starts read-only, and includes a Docker Compose demo. On Windows, PowerShell needs no Python or redis-cli.

posts.name: Fable Fiesta
posts.tagline: Play DnD online with AI Dungeon Master
posts.description: Play DnD online with AI Dungeon Master Create detailed DnD maps, world maps, campaigns, monsters, new homebrew races, classes and monsters and create your DnD characters

posts.name: Periodic table laboratory
posts.tagline: Periodic Table Laboratory is a safe chemistry playground
posts.description: Snap atoms together, discover molecules and find out what everyday things are made of! Periodic Table Laboratory is a safe, offline chemistry playground for curious kids aged 5 to 13. Drag atoms onto the lab bench and watch them snap together. Make water, oxygen, carbon dioxide and table salt. Dots show each atom's free "hands", and when every hand is full your molecule is complete.

posts.name: chatface
posts.tagline: Skip the call. Book a time, meet in a text chat.
posts.description: Not every meeting needs a camera. chatface is a booking link for text-only meetings. Share your link, people pick a time, and a private chat room opens at that minute and closes by itself after 30 minutes. No video, no audio, no app, and guests never create an account. Made for noisy homes, bad Wi-Fi and people who think better in writing. Free to start. Pro adds live translation, AI notes with next steps and disappearing messages.

posts.name: PowerMode
posts.tagline: Typing effects and key sounds for your Mac
posts.description: PowerMode is a menu bar app that brings typing effects and key sounds to your Mac. Every key sets off a burst at your cursor, stirs a sky across your screen and lands with a click. Pick Confetti, Bubbles, Flowers, Hearts, Notes or Lanterns for your cursor, and a sky of Starfield, Wind, Autumn leaves, Snow or Rain for your screen. It can blur and dim other windows while you type, and bring your desktop back when you stop. Works in the apps you write in, from Mail and Chrome to VS Code and Slack.

posts.name: Fader
posts.tagline: Volume control for every app on your Mac
posts.description: Every app that plays sound gets its own fader in your menu bar, like the volume mixer on Windows. Turn music down for a call, boost a quiet video to 150%, mute noisy apps with a click. Built on Apple's own audio API, so there's no driver to install. $4.99 once.

posts.name: Sarj AI
posts.tagline: Arabic-first AI voice agents for enterprise workflows
posts.description: Sarj AI builds Arabic-first voice and chat agents for enterprise support, sales follow-up and collections. Based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, it connects conversations to business workflows through APIs.

posts.name: PromptEditor – Prompt Notebook
posts.tagline: PromptEditor: The notebook for everything you ask AI.
posts.description: PromptEditor is a free Chrome side panel for everything you write to AI. Draft prompts like notes, keep them in an unlimited library with tags, and reuse them with [placeholders] and global variables. Send any prompt to ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity or Copilot in one click, or pull an AI reply into the panel to edit it. It doubles as a scratchpad for calls and quick notes. No account, no servers: everything stays in your browser.

posts.name: pomela
posts.tagline: Build reliable, full-stack apps with AI
posts.description: Pomela is an AI-powered platform built around reliability. Create complete, functional applications and websites from natural language, without writing code. Our mission is to make AI-generated software more dependable, from the initial build to every edit and deployment. Now in public beta. Available in 16 languages. Free to try.
